---
title:
  "Moloch: A Minimalist, Feature-Rich Beamer Theme"
description: >
  An introduction to Moloch, a minimalist LaTeX beamer theme that revives and
  fixes the popular but unmaintained Metropolis theme. (TUGboat 2026)
author:
  - Johan Larsson
  - samcarter
abstract: >
  Moloch is a fork of the popular, but unmaintained, LaTeX Beamer theme
  Metropolis. It fixes outstanding  issues in Metropolis while preserving the
  original minimalist design. In this article we introduce Moloch’s features and
  options, provide guidance for Metropolis users transitioning to Moloch, and
  describe the documentation system that we use to generate both PDF and HTML
  documentation.
